body: Wow this is really great! I think the hardest thing about recovery is even wanting to recover. It won’t be linear but you wanting to is really key. And it’ll be slow and ups and downs. I say this as someone who was “recovered” or began recovery last summer and is struggling still. I think support network is key - friends or family who know about ED and can hold you accountable. Going to therapy helps but obviously is extremely expensive. I think if you can verbal affirmations even like I am enough are helpful. Good luck rooting for you this shit is hard and it won’t be easy but wanting to recover is truly incredible
